content.stem: 在进行反洗钱调查时,审计员应遵循哪项关于保护隐私和数据的原则？

options.A: 反洗钱法和数据保护隐私法不应相互排斥.
options.B: 在收集证据期间,隐私法不如当地的反洗钱法重要.
options.C: 恐怖主义融资在数据保护的背景下更为重要,并凌驾于法律之上.
options.D: 各国应明确反洗钱和数据保护隐私法不相平衡之处.

content.stem_en: Which principle about safeguarding privacy and data should an auditor adhere to when performing an AML investigation?

options_en.A: AML and data protection privacy laws should not be mutually exclusive
options_en.B: During evidence gathering, privacy laws are less important than local AML laws
options_en.C: Terrorist financing is more relevant in the context of data protection and supersedes laws
options_en.D: Countries should clarify where AML and data protection privacy laws are not balanced
